owner_semantics: Role-based functional ownership is assigned for governance; no person or external fact is invented.

gates.activation_condition: A selected future route or surface requires a trusted caller identity.
positive_tests: trusted identity maps to the expected subject and audience
negative_tests: missing, forged or wrong-audience identity is rejected
gates.stop_condition: Identity source or subject ownership is unproven.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x external gate before any route exposure

gates.activation_condition: A selected surface is considered for a caller beyond the local test boundary.
positive_tests: valid authenticated caller reaches only the authorized boundary
negative_tests: anonymous, expired and malformed credentials are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Authentication behavior cannot be evidenced at the same boundary.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x external gate before any route exposure

gates.activation_condition: A route disposition would permit a caller to read or mutate governed data.
positive_tests: authorized subject can access only the approved capability
negative_tests: same-tenant wrong-role, missing-capability and privilege-escalation bypasses are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Capability and resource authorization are not explicit.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x policy gate; required again in selected 4.x family

gates.activation_condition: A route can observe or change tenant-scoped resources.
positive_tests: tenant-scoped subject sees only its own approved resources
negative_tests: cross-tenant identifier, list and filter bypasses are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Tenant boundary is inferred from static source only.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x external gate before any tenant exposure

gates.activation_condition: A browser or external client would call the surface across origins.
positive_tests: approved origin receives the intended bounded response
negative_tests: unapproved origin and wildcard credential bypasses are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Trusted origins and edge enforcement are not approved.

gates.activation_condition: A route would be treated as deployed, externally reachable or public.
positive_tests: approved deployment reaches only the intended bounded route
negative_tests: unapproved ingress, public exposure and wrong-host bypasses are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Deployment or traffic evidence is unavailable.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x external gate before any exposure claim

gates.activation_condition: Settings are read, changed or treated as authority for another surface.
positive_tests: approved non-secret setting follows the explicit owner contract
negative_tests: unknown field, unauthorized write and provider-authority bypass are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Settings ownership or storage destination is ambiguous.

gates.activation_condition: A response, log or persisted record could contain secret-bearing material.
positive_tests: approved secret-shaped input is redacted at every output boundary
negative_tests: raw secret, nested secret and error-path disclosure are rejected
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x gate before settings, logs or provider surfaces

gates.activation_condition: A credential or secret would be stored or used operationally.
positive_tests: approved rotation invalidates the prior credential and preserves policy
negative_tests: expired, revoked and reused credential paths are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Rotation and revocation ownership is missing.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x external gate before provider or deployment activation

gates.activation_condition: A route or future block would write or read governed persistent data.
positive_tests: approved operation uses only the named destination and owner
negative_tests: unowned destination, path escape and cross-tenant persistence are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Product-store ownership or destination is unproven.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x gate before any operational persistence claim

gates.activation_condition: Data, logs, memory, settings or evidence would persist beyond a request.
positive_tests: approved record follows the declared retention and deletion policy
negative_tests: indefinite retention, wrong-tenant retention and undeletable record paths are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Retention owner or deletion semantics are absent.

gates.activation_condition: A future write-capable family claims operational recovery or restore.
positive_tests: approved restore returns the governed boundary to a known valid state
negative_tests: partial restore, wrong-tenant restore and unowned recovery paths are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Product recovery is only inferred from sandbox rollback.

gates.activation_condition: A selected route or block could invoke a provider or expose provider metadata.
positive_tests: approved provider call uses the named credential boundary and policy
negative_tests: missing, wrong-scope and unapproved provider credential paths are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Credential, provider or cost evidence is absent.

gates.activation_condition: A future block would make DNS, HTTP, socket or provider traffic.
positive_tests: approved destination is reachable only through the bounded policy
negative_tests: unapproved DNS, socket, HTTP and redirect egress paths are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Egress authority or external traffic evidence is missing.

gates.activation_condition: Agent, team or paper artifacts would become active or executable.
positive_tests: approved activation remains within the named workforce contract
negative_tests: declarative artifact, missing approval and inactive-to-active bypasses are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Workforce activation authority is not explicitly approved.
gates.minimum_phase: 3.x gate before any active workforce claim

gates.activation_condition: A route would create, reveal, update, delete, reset or transition governed state.
positive_tests: approved transition follows the named lifecycle and confirmation policy
negative_tests: invalid transition, replay, reset or terminal-state bypass is rejected
gates.stop_condition: Lifecycle authority or terminal behavior is ambiguous.

gates.activation_condition: A future operation can partially fail or require rollback/recovery.
positive_tests: bounded failure returns the boundary to the prior valid checkpoint
negative_tests: partial mutation, double recovery and recovery into an unowned state are rejected

gates.activation_condition: A route disposition could preserve, alter or remove a consumer-visible contract.
positive_tests: known consumer contract remains stable under the bounded policy
negative_tests: unknown consumer, incompatible payload and silent retirement paths are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Consumer impact or compatibility obligation is unknown.

gates.activation_condition: A future implementation would change request, response, permission or confirmation semantics.
positive_tests: approved request and response follow the existing bounded contract
negative_tests: payload v2 invention, forbidden field, shape drift and authority bypass are rejected
gates.stop_condition: Payload ownership or semantic compatibility is ambiguous.
